text:
Predicates:
Library(x) ::: x currently works in the library.
CSdept(x) ::: x is from the computer science department.
PartTimeJob(x) ::: x has a part-time job offered by the university.
Database(x) ::: x is taking the database course.
David(x) ::: x is taking a class with Professor David.
Lab(x) ::: x works in the lab.
Premises:
∀x (Library(x) ∧ Student(x) → ¬CSdept(x)) ::: None of the students who currently work in the library are from the computer science department.
∀x (PartTimeJob(x) ∧ Student(x) → Library(x)) ::: All of the students with part-time jobs offered by the university currently work in the library.
∀x (Database(x) → CSdept(x)) ::: All of the students who are taking the database course are from the computer science department.
∀x (David(x) → Database(x)) ::: All of the students taking a class with Professor David are taking the database course.
∀x (Lab(x) → David(x)) ::: All students working in the lab are taking a class with Professor David.
Lab(james) ::: James is a student working in the lab.
¬(Lab(james) ∨ PartTimeJob(james)) ::: James doesn't work in the lab or have a part-time job offered by the university.
Conclusion:
Database(james) ::: James takes the database course.
